```{r libraries, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.cap="Scatterplot of diamond price and carat. There is a positive relationship between price and carat, although it may not be linear and has increasing noise as carat increases."}
ggplot(diamonds) +
  geom_point(aes(carat, price))
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
